semantic.justification: Native ScChartListener range-list/token-vector constructors retain actual FormulaToken identities,copy the by-value vector,own the name value and preserve false used/dirty defaults. GetRangeList allocates fresh ranges at the default origin;SetRangeList replaces tokens without changing flags. Equality retains document/name/flag/emptiness/token-pointer comparisons,including unequal independently generated equal ranges. Ordinary GC is the existing intrusive-token reference adaptation. Live chart notification,external links,UNO,chart loading and Idle collection scheduling remain unported;this owner is not installed as a complete chart service.
